title: Seven Minutes of Terror
goal: Survive entry, descent and landing on Mars.

edl.delta.title: TOUCHDOWN AT THE DELTA
edl.delta.text: Wheels down in Jezero Crater, right beside an ancient river delta. The science team is jumping for joy.

edl.plains.title: TOUCHDOWN ON THE PLAINS
edl.plains.text: A smooth landing on flat ground. Building here will be easy, though the rocks are far away.

edl.crash.title: LANDER LOST
edl.crash.text: The lander hit the ground too hard. Mission Control only learns the news 11 minutes later.
edl.crash.lesson: Landing is the riskiest part of a Mars mission. Backups like terrain navigation and early engine firing save landers.

edl.burnthrough.title: HEAT SHIELD FAILED
edl.burnthrough.text: The hot spot grew into a hole. The capsule could not survive the fire of entry.
edl.burnthrough.lesson: Heat shields must be checked before entry. A damaged shield can fail under 1,300 degrees Celsius.
